observed_problem: No converged substep after eight Newton iterations; force residual oscillates around 0.0031-0.0048 N against about 0.00052 N criterion. No negative pivots or memory limit. Original run is stopped for numerical diagnosis before timeout; it remains unqualified.
diagnosis_scope: Observed nonlinear residual plateau. Contact multiplier/stiffness-update chatter is a hypothesis to isolate, not a proven root cause or a measured poor physical design.
rationale: Pure penalty with fixed initial normal stiffness removes augmented-Lagrange multiplier corrections and iteration-dependent stiffness updates while retaining frictionless unilateral contact. Verify small-rectangle force, penetration, signed contact force, equilibrium and repeatability before any new full-model solve.
